text:
Sasha (AE): Quick heads-up - BlueWave POC is blocked. Trying to provision a Dedicated GPU pool in ap-southeast-1 and it keeps failing. They're asking for dates and pricing too.

Maya (SE): Seeing the same in the web UI logs. Provision request returns 500 then 429 on retries. Started a ticket with Eng infra but wanted to loop sales + SRE.

Jorge (PlatformEng): Can you paste the control-plane request id or a snippet of the error? Might be AZ affinity or the reservation config not matching available SKUs.

Maya (SE): Request ID: req_0a9f2c71. Example error from control plane:
```json
{"error":"capacity_unavailable","region":"ap-southeast-1","code":"POOL_ERR_32","details":"requested reservation profile not matchable to any active GPU SKU in region"}
```

Rowan (Oncall): I'm seeing a burst of 429s from the provisioning API around that req. Likely quota/stock depletion rather than a bug. I pushed a temporary autoscale fallback to allow smaller instances.

Sasha (AE): BlueWave specifically asked for A100-40G equivalent and single-AZ placement. Their compliance wants AZ affinity for data residency. If we can't match A100 in that AZ, it's a deal blocker.

Anita (CSM): Also they pinged on pricing: estimate for a 4x A100 reserved pool for 3 months - can we get a ballpark? They want to include numbers in an internal ROI doc today.

billing-bot: Ballpark: reserved 4xA100 (monthly commit) ~ $22,400/mo before discounts. For short-term POC we can offer a trial credit instead of full commit. Reach out to pricing@ for formal quote.

Jorge (PlatformEng): Two paths: 1) if AZ affinity is strict we need to check supplier inventory for that AZ and reservation mapping. 2) if they can relax to cross-AZ within same region we can provision immediately with the autoscale fallback Rowan enabled.

Maya (SE): BlueWave replied - AZ affinity is required for certs and routing. Can't relax. They also sent a security question about KMS/KP management and network peering.

Jorge (PlatformEng): For KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments only; hosted Dedicated can use our managed KMS with audit logs. I asked infra to confirm whether a Private trial is feasible for them.

Rowan (Oncall): I'm opening a capacity escalation to CloudOps to check actual inventory in ap-southeast-1 AZ-b. Tagging @cloud-ops. Note: provisioning API returns this internal trace snippet in our logs: 
```
TRACE req_0a9f2c71 -> pool_create -> match_reservation_profiles -> no_match -> POOL_ERR_32
Host: control-plane-7
Response: 200 -> 429 -> 500 -> final 500
```

Maya (SE): If CloudOps confirms zero available matching SKUs we should offer an immediate alternative: 1) same-region different AZ + VPN/peering config guidance, or 2) temporary Dedicated on nearest region (ap-southeast-2) + data transfer plan. Need ops to confirm replication/failover implications.

Sasha (AE): BlueWave says ap-southeast-2 adds latency >30ms unacceptable. They may walk if we can't meet AZ affinity.

Jorge (PlatformEng): I'll run the supplier inventory check and reservation matcher now. CMD I ran internally: 
```bash
# internal only
redwoodctl supplier inventory --region ap-southeast-1 --sku a100-40g --az az-b
# then:
redwoodctl pools create --profile reserved-4x --az az-b --region ap-southeast-1 --tenant bluewave --request-id req_0a9f2c71
```
Posting results in ~10m.

Anita (CSM): BlueWave also needs a short security Q doc answered: network peering, KMS, log retention, SOC2. I have the template - ping me and I'll add the infra answers once we have capacity confirmation.

Sasha (AE): Thank you all. @Jorge @Rowan please prioritize - this is mid-committee decision for the customer. I'll hold off on pricing until we know capacity, but we should be ready to offer the trial credit path.

deploy-bot: [provisioning] Started async job: job_9f3a. Status: queued.

Rowan (Oncall): Update: CloudOps confirms no matching A100-40G stock in ap-southeast-1 AZ-b for reserved profile. They recommend either (a) cross-AZ tolerant config or (b) expedited procurement which takes ~5 business days.

Maya (SE): I'll message BlueWave with those options and include the security answers we can provide now. Also prepping a short script they can run if they want to test smaller spot-backed instances in-target AZ while we procure.

Sasha (AE): Good. Please keep me posted. If procurement ETA slips we'll need to escalate to sales leadership for a concession.

Jorge (PlatformEng): Result of inventory command:
```json
{"region":"ap-southeast-1","az":"az-b","sku":"a100-40g","available":0,"pending_restock":true,"restock_eta":"2026-03-30T12:00:00Z"}
```

Rowan (Oncall): Filed incident INC-2026-117 for the restock and linked this thread.

Sasha (AE): Copy. I'll pause commitments with BlueWave until March 30th ETA confirmed. Thanks team. :pray:
